about: NHLPA '93 (SNES) instruments <-> General MIDI. The game has no instrument names, so every row rests on measurements: one probe note per instrument played through the game's own SPC700 program (data/audio/nhl93s-instrument-analysis.json, rebuilt by tools/build-snes-gm-analysis.js) and how the retail songs use it. Each row has a confidence and a runner-up. Nothing was auditioned: edit by ear. Instruments 12-26 are used only by sound effects and are not mapped. Notes use MIDI = note index + 12 for every instrument (docs/NHL93S-SOUND.md).

0.why: the bass of the boot songs. 1636 notes, MIDI 20-41 in cues 1,2,3,9. Measured: plucked, attack 70 ms, -30 dB at key-off, brightness 3.1x, periodicity 0.98

1.why: low thump on the drum parts. 1027 notes, MIDI 31-31 (one fixed key) in cues 1,2,3,9. Measured: plucked, attack 5 ms, -60 dB at key-off, brightness 1.8x, periodicity 0.99
